outcome.problem: Executives receive fragmented dashboards after problems occur rather than one evidence-backed view of cross-functional risk, action, and opportunity.
outcome.target_outcome: Create a daily operating view of revenue, cash, customers, service, marketing, and cross-functional priorities tied to verified source evidence.
success_criteria: All included Plays install into Gravitre's canonical Play/workflow runtime.
Every Play reads only registered source-of-record actions in the tested/governed v1 profile.
Every declared KPI is represented in the installed dashboard and normalized dataset.
At least one declared outcome event must be measured before Outcome Verified status is earned.
Every evidence action resolves through canonical Play readiness and the pack runtime profile.
Record-specific reviews require explicit runtime IDs before execution.
Cross-system joins require verified identity mappings and complete measurement coverage.
Prepared reviews are activity evidence; outcome improvement requires a measured baseline and source-linked result.

agents.name: Executive Intelligence Agent
agents.purpose: Operate Executive evidence review and measurable decision support. Show source, observation time, reporting window, currency, materiality threshold, and missing coverage for every signal; do not sum unlike risk scores. Join revenue, accounting, and support accounts only through verified mappings; preserve department-level exposure when a join is unavailable. Rank evidence-backed impact and urgency, propose owner and due date, and distinguish recommendation from accepted ownership and verified resolution. Use aligned historical windows for anomaly detection. A current snapshot does not prove trend, causal impact, resolved risk, or financial savings.
